description: Deutsche Bahn publishes open data and APIs about the German railway. The former open data portal says that from March 2024 its open data move to the Mobilithek, GovData and the Opendata-ÖPNV platform, while APIs stay on the DB API Marketplace. DB InfraGO provides data on the current traffic situation, stations and their infrastructure: the Timetables API gives the relevant part of the planned timetable and current deviations from it, the StaDa station data API gives station contacts, coordinates, opening hours and facilities such as parking, taxi ranks, toilets, Wi-Fi and step-free access, and the FaSta API gives the location and current operating status of lifts and escalators. The rail network geometry (Schienennetz Deutsche Bahn) is listed on GovData as GeoJSON, CSV, GeoPackage and WMS files dated April 2022. Coverage is national. DB InfraGO offers the data for free use, and the APIs are reached through the DB API Marketplace with its API catalogue and getting-started guide. Caveats: after the move the datasets are spread over several portals and some old dataset pages no longer resolve, and the network file has not been refreshed since 2022. The data support passenger rail digital twins, station accessibility analysis and delay and disruption studies. They complement the Network Rail open data feeds in Great Britain and are related to the Mobilithek.
